question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a blue ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a gold ball, Dave has a yellow ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a brown ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Finally, Bob and Fred swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) blue ball
(B) white ball
(C) gold ball
(D) yellow ball
(E) black ball
(F) brown ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Each row lists the ball colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: blue | white | gold | yellow | black | brown | pink
1. Gertrude ↔ Dave: blue | white | gold | pink | black | brown | yellow
2. Gertrude ↔ Fred: blue | white | gold | pink | black | yellow | brown
3. Claire ↔ Alice: gold | white | blue | pink | black | yellow | brown
4. Gertrude ↔ Fred: gold | white | blue | pink | black | brown | yellow
5. Alice ↔ Gertrude: yellow | white | blue | pink | black | brown | gold
6. Bob ↔ Gertrude: yellow | gold | blue | pink | black | brown | white
7. Bob ↔ Fred: yellow | brown | blue | pink | black | gold | white
Fred has the gold ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
